sentences.text: My grandfather helped ______________ the City Bank many years ago.
Her ______________ in the office is to sell products to customers.
After months of talks, the two sides finally reached an ______________.
The only time I see my uncles is at our ______________ family picnic.
Students who work hard ______________ good grades.
After I passed the test, I was able to ______________ my driver's license.
The girls were ______________ for the chance to visit their grandfather.

part3.label: Read the story, then circle T (true) or F (false).
part3.hint: The vocabulary words are printed in bold.  ·  1 mark each
part3.story: Last summer, Omar visited an old royal palace with a bunch of friends. Their guide, Miss Layla, was famous for her intelligence — she had studied the palace for twenty years. While they were walking, Omar noticed a gap between two stones in the wall. Under the dust on the surface, there was a small door. “Are you kidding me?” laughed his friend Ali. “That's ridiculous — there are no secret rooms here!” But Miss Layla opened the door, and they found a hidden chamber full of old boxes. Inside one box, there was a golden crown. Sadly, tests later showed the crown was fake — a clever copy made a hundred years ago. Still, the discovery brought great glory to the little museum, and Omar's photo appeared in the national newspaper.

statements.text: Omar visited the palace with a group of friends.
Miss Layla was known for being very clever.
Omar noticed a gap between two stones in the floor.
Ali believed there were secret rooms in the palace.
The small door was easy to see because the surface was clean.
The hidden chamber was full of old boxes.
The golden crown was real royal treasure.
The crown was a copy made about a hundred years ago.
The discovery brought honour to the little museum.
Ali was serious when he asked about the secret door.

part4.label: Grammar — Present Perfect Continuous.
part4.hint: Read the requirement in red brackets, then write your answer.  ·  1 mark each

items.sentence: They have been playing football since this morning.
items.answer: They haven't been playing football since this morning.

items.sentence: Sara has been learning French ______________ two years.
I work in this school for five years.
items.answer: I have been working in this school for five years.

items.sentence: My father has been driving a taxi ______________ twenty years.
We have waiting here for two hours.
items.answer: We have been waiting here for two hours.

items.sentence: It has been raining ______________ I left the house.
She has been watching TV all afternoon.
items.answer: She hasn't been watching TV all afternoon.

items.sentence: I have been knowing him since we were children.
items.answer: I have known him since we were children.
